description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand and allowing an opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
